title: Seven killed and 23 missing in boat capsizing off northern Cyprus
english: A passenger ferry carrying over 260 people capsized off the coast of Northern Cyprus after being struck by powerful waves. Authorities have confirmed at least seven deaths, with dozens of others remaining missing despite ongoing rescue efforts by sea and air. The vessel’s captain and crew are currently in custody as officials investigate potential negligence regarding the incident.
amharic: በሰሜን ሳይፕረስ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ ከ260 በላይ ሰዎችን የጫነ የባህር ጉዞ መርከብ በኃይለኛ ማዕበል ተመትቶ ሰምጧል። አደጋው የቢያንስ ሰባት ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ሰዎች አሁንም የሉም። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት የመርከቧን ካፒቴን እና ሰራተኞች በቁጥጥር ስር በማዋል በግድየለሽነት ላይ ምርመራ እየጀመሩ ሲሆን፣ የነፍስ አድን ስራውም አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Dooniin imaltoota 260 ol baatte tokko qarqara galaana Kaaba Qupiroositti weerara bishaanitiin erga rukutamtee booda gombifamteerti. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota torbaa darbuun mirkanaa'eera, namoonni hedduun ammoo ammallee bakka bu'aan isaanii hin beekamu. Hojiiwwan fayyisuu ammayyuu kan itti fufan yoo ta'u, qondaaltonni mootummaa balicha irratti qorannoo geggeessuuf jecha kabitaanii fi hojjettoota doonii sana to'annoo jala oolchaniiru.

title: Nepal’s flood survivors search for missing loved ones
english: Nepal is currently facing a dire humanitarian crisis following devastating floods that have claimed nearly 800 lives. Rescue teams are working tirelessly to find survivors, including those trapped under debris, while thousands of people remain unaccounted for. Families are enduring a heartbreaking search, scanning images of victims in hopes of locating their missing relatives.
amharic: በኔፓል በደረሰው ከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ የ800 ሰዎች ሕይወት ሲያልፍ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በፈራረሱ ቤቶች ውስጥ ተጠልፈው የሚገኙ ሰዎችን ለማዳን ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ቤተሰቦችም የጠፉ ዘመዶቻቸውን ለማግኘት በከፍተኛ ጭንቀት ውስጥ ሆነው የተገኙ አስከሬኖችን ምስል በመመልከት ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Neepaali keessatti lolaa hamaa mudateen lubbuun namoota 800 ol kan darbe yoo ta'u, namoonni kuma sadii ol immoo bakka bu'an hin beekamu. Gareen gargaarsaa gamoo fi xurii jala kan qabaman oolchuuf dadhabbiin hojjechaa jiru. Maatiin namoota isaanii dhaban immoo fira isaanii barbaachaaf suuraa reeffa argame ilaaluun gaddaan guutamanii jiru.

title: NASA launches $4.3bn Roman Telescope to uncover universe’s hidden secrets
english: NASA has successfully launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, a $4.3 billion project designed to explore the mysteries of dark energy, dark matter, and planets outside our solar system. Carried by a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket, the observatory is traveling to a distant point in space where it will spend years mapping billions of galaxies. This mission aims to significantly improve our understanding of how the universe is structured and how rapidly it is expanding.
amharic: ናሳ የ4.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ወጪ የተደረገበትን የናንሲ ግሬስ ሮማን የጠፈር ቴሌስኮፕ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ወደ ጠፈር አስጀምሯል። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ስለ ጨለማ ጉልበት፣ ጨለማ ቁስ እና ከፀሐይ ስርአታችን ውጭ ያሉ ፕላኔቶችን ምስጢራት ለመመርመር ያለመ ነው። በስፔስ ኤክስ ሮኬት የተላከው ይህ ቴሌስኮፕ በቢሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ ጋላክሲዎችን በመቃኘት የአጽናፈ ሰማይን አፈጣጠር እና መስፋፋት በተመለከተ አዳዲስ እውቀቶችን ይሰጣል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: NASA'n teleskopii haaraa 'Nancy Grace Roman' jedhamu kan gatiin isaa biliyoona 4.3 ta'u injifannoon gara hawaatti ergeera. Teleskopichi iccitii 'dark energy', 'dark matter' fi pilaanetoota sirna biiftuu keenya alatti argaman qorachuuf gargaara. Rokketii SpaceX Falcon Heavy jedhamuun gara iddoo fagoo ergame kun, galaksiiwwan biliyoonaan lakkaa'aman qorachuun, bal'inaa fi caasaa addunyaa keenya hubachuuf gumaacha guddaa gochuu ni danda'a.

title: Trump threatens to report journalist Kristen Welker to broadcast regulator
english: President Donald Trump has announced plans to report NBC journalist Kristen Welker to the Federal Communications Commission. He claims her assessment of his election endorsements as having mixed results is inaccurate and misleading to the public. This action reflects his ongoing strategy of using federal regulatory oversight to challenge news organizations he views as biased.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኤንቢሲዋን ጋዜጠኛ ክሪስቲን ዌልከርን ለፌዴራል ኮሙኒኬሽን ኮሚሽን (FCC) እንደሚከሷት አስታውቀዋል። ጋዜጠኛዋ የሱ የምርጫ ድጋፍ ውጤት የተቀላቀለ ነው በማለቷ፣ መረጃዋ የተሳሳተ እና ህዝብን የሚያሳስት ነው ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ድርጊት አድሎአዊ ናቸው ብለው የሚያስቧቸውን የሚዲያ ተቋማት ለመገዳደር የፌዴራል ቁጥጥር ተቋማትን የመጠቀም የትራምፕ ቀጣይ አካሄድ አካል ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp gaazexeessituu NBC Kristen Welker irratti komii gara Komishinii Kominikeeshinii Federaalaa (FCC) dhiyeessuuf karoora qaban beeksisaniiru. Ibsa gaazexeessituun kun deggeroota isaan filannoo irratti qaban ilaalchisee kennite dogoggoraa fi hawaasa wallaalchisuudha jedhaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun miidiyaaleen wal-lootuudha jedhanii amananii fi tarkaanfii fudhachuuf dhaabbata federaalaa fayyadamuu akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Zambia opposition leader Brian Mundubile charged with treason
english: Zambian opposition politician Brian Mundubile and his associate Makebi Zulu have been formally accused of treason. Mundubile, who headed the NRPUP party and finished as the runner-up in the August 13 election, had previously attempted to contest the poll results. However, his legal efforts were unsuccessful after courts became inaccessible before the filing deadline.
amharic: የዛምቢያው የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ መሪ ብራያን ሙንዱቢሌ እና ምክትላቸው ማኬቢ ዙሉ በአገር ክህደት ወንጀል ተከሰሱ። ኤንአርፒዩፒ የተሰኘውን ፓርቲ የሚመሩት ሙንዱቢሌ፣ ነሐሴ 13 በተካሄደው አወዛጋቢ ምርጫ ሁለተኛ ደረጃን ይዘው ነበር። የያዙትን የምርጫ ውጤት ለመቃወም የሞከሩ ቢሆንም፣ ፍርድ ቤቶች በተቀመጠው የጊዜ ገደብ ምክንያት ባለመክፈታቸው ሙከራቸው ሳይሳካ ቀርቷል።
oromo: Hogganaan mormituu Zambiyaa Biraayan Munduubiile fi gargaartonni isaa Makeebii Zuuluu yakka gantootummaan himatamaniiru. Munduubiile hogganaa paartii NRPUP ta'uun filannoo Hagayya 13 gaggeeffame keessatti bakka lammaffaa kan qabatan yoo ta'u, bu'aa filannichaa mormuuf yaalii godhaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, mana murtii sadarkaa isaanii dhiyaachuu kan dhaban ta'uun, carraaqqiin isaanii sun milkaa'uu hin dandeenye.

title: Israeli forces shoot two Palestinians during settler attacks near Ramallah
english: Two Palestinians were injured by live gunfire during a violent encounter involving Israeli settlers near the village of al-Mughayyir in the occupied West Bank. Local officials reported that Israeli forces facilitated the settler attacks by blocking access to the area for residents. Medical teams transported the wounded to nearby hospitals for emergency treatment following the confrontation.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አል-ሙጋዪር መንደር አቅራቢያ በተፈጠረ ግጭት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን በእስራኤል ኃይሎች እና በሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ቆስለዋል። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት እስራኤላውያን ወታደሮች ሰፈራቸውን ለማስጠበቅ የአካባቢውን መንገድ በመዝጋት ለጥቃቱ ምቹ ሁኔታን ፈጥረዋል። ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሰዎች በአስቸኳይ ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደው ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Qilleensa Qabamee jiru kan West Bank, baadiyyaa al-Mughayyiritti, haleellaa qonnaan bultoota Israa'elii fi waraana Israa'el irra ga'een namoonni Falasxiin lama miidhamaniiru. Hogganoonni naannichaa akka ibsanitti, waraanni Israa'el karaa cufuudhaan haleellaa qonnaan bultootaaf akka mijatu gochuu isaanii beekameera. Namoonni miidhaan irra ga'e kunis gara mana yaalaatti geeffamanii yaalamaniiru.

title: Mecca pact's first trilateral meeting to be held in Istanbul on Monday
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan are holding their first trilateral meeting in Istanbul this Monday following the recent signing of a mutual defense agreement in Mecca. The high-level talks will include foreign ministers, defense officials, and military leaders from all three nations. This security pact establishes a collective defense framework, meaning that any aggression against one participating country will be considered an attack on all of them.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በቅርቡ በሜካ ከተፈራረሙት የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት በኋላ የመጀመሪያውን የሶስትዮሽ ስብሰባ ሰኞ በኢስታንቡል ሊያካሂዱ ነው። በስብሰባው ላይ የሶስቱ ሀገራት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች፣ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሮች እና ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ መሪዎች ይሳተፋሉ። ይህ ስምምነት በአንዱ ሀገር ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሶስቱም ሀገራት ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ጥቃት እንደሚቆጠር ይደነግጋል።
oromo: Turkiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan waligaltee ittisa biyyaalessaa kan Ka'abaatti mallatteessan booda walgahii isaanii isa jalqabaa Dilbata kana Istanbulitti gaggeessuuf karoorfataniiru. Walgahii kana irratti ministiroonni alaa, ministiroonni ittisaa fi ajajoonni waraanaa biyyoota sadanii ni hirmaatu. Walgaliin kun biyyoota sadeen keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, haleellaan sun akka waan sadeen irrattuu raawwatametti kan ilaalamu ta'uu mirkaneessa.

title: Tanker struck by projectile in Hormuz, UKMTO says
english: A commercial tanker was hit by an unidentified object while passing through the Strait of Hormuz near Oman on Saturday. British maritime authorities reported the incident but confirmed that there were no injuries or environmental damage. Officials are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the attack.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል ሲያልፍ የነበረ የንግድ መርከብ በማይታወቅ ነገር ተመትቷል። የብሪታንያ የባህር ላይ ንግድ ኦፕሬሽን ኤጀንሲ እንደገለጸው በሰውም ሆነ በአካባቢ ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም። ባለስልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት ክስተቱን በማጣራት ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Sambata darbe markabni daldalaa tokko yommuu handhuura Hormuz ce'u miidhaan irra ga'eera. Abbootiin taayitaa bishaan keessa deemaa kan Biritish akka ibsanitti, miidhaa qaamaa ykn faalama naannoo tokkollee hin geenye. Ammaaf qaamoleen dhimmi ilaallatu qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: British activist abducted by armed Israeli settlers in Masafer Yatta
english: A British activist named Finn Joughin was forcibly detained by armed Israeli settlers in the West Bank village of Umm al-Khair before being transferred to police custody. While settlers claim the detention was related to sexual abuse allegations, legal representatives state he was held in a shed after shielding a child near a fence. The British government is currently in contact with Israeli officials to investigate the situation as the activist prepares for a court appearance.
amharic: ፊን ጆጊን የተባሉ ብሪታንያዊ አክቲቪስት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ኡም አል-ካይር መንደር በታጠቁ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች ተይዘው ለፖሊስ ተላልፈው ተሰጥተዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ በወሲባዊ ጥቃት ክስ እንዳሰሩዋቸው ቢናገሩም፣ የህግ አማካሪዎቻቸው ግን አክቲቪስቱ ህፃን ልጅን ለመከላከል ሲሞክሩ በግዳጅ ታግተው እንደነበር ይናገራሉ። የብሪታንያ መንግስት የጉዳዩን ሂደት እየተከታተለ ሲሆን፣ አክቲቪስቱም በኢየሩሳሌም ፍርድ ቤት ቀርበው ክርክር ያደርጋሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Goggeessaan lammii Biriitish Finn Joughin jedhamu, baadiyaa Umm al-Khair kan West Bank keessatti hidhattoota qe'ee qabachuu barbaadan isiraa'elootaan humnaan qabamee poolisiif dabarfame. Gaggeessitootni kun himannaa saalaan walqabate akka jiru ibsanus, abukaattoon isaa garuu inni ijoollee eeguuf yaaluun isaa gidiraa akka isatti ta'e ibsu. Mootummaan Biriitish haala kana hordofaa jiru yoo ta'u, inniis torban kana mana murtiitti dhiyaatee falmata jedhamee eegama.

title: Canada installs large Lake Ontario sign in latest jab at US
english: Ontario Premier Doug Ford has installed a sign asserting the name 'Lake Ontario' after President Trump issued an executive order to rename the body of water 'Lake America.' This move follows a breakdown in trade negotiations that led to new tariffs being imposed between the two countries. While Google Maps has updated its labels for US users to reflect the change, Canadian officials maintain that the name will remain the same.
amharic: የኦንታሪዮ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዳግ ፎርድ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የኦንታሪዮ ሐይቅን ስም ወደ 'አሜሪካ ሐይቅ' ለመቀየር ትዕዛዝ ካስተላለፉ በኋላ የሐይቁ ስም 'ኦንታሪዮ' መሆኑን የሚያረጋግጥ ታፔላ አስቀምጠዋል። ይህ ውዝግብ የተፈጠረው በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የተደረገው የንግድ ድርድር በመቋረጡ እና አዲስ የታሪፍ ግብሮች በመጣላቸው ነው። ጎግል ማፕስ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ለሚገኙ ተጠቃሚዎች ስሙን ቢቀይርም፣ የካናዳ ባለስልጣናት ግን የሐይቁ ስም ሳይቀየር እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Ontaariyoo Daag Foord, pirezidaanti Traamp haroo Ontaariyoo maqaa 'Haroo Ameerikaa' jedhuun jijjiiruuf ajaja dabarsanii booda, maqaan harichaa 'Ontaariyoo' akka ta'e ibsuuf mallattoo guddaa dhaabaniiru. Wal-dhabdeen kun kan uumame erga daldalli biyyoota lamaan gidduu ture diigamee fi gibriin haaraa erga irratti dabamee booda. Google Maps itti fayyadamtoota Yuunaayitid Isteetsiif maqicha jijjiirus, hoggantoonni Kaanaadaa maqaan harichaa akka hin jijjiiramne ibsaniiru.

title: How does your name taste? The strange science of synaesthesia
english: Synaesthesia is a unique neurological condition where one sensory experience, such as hearing a name, automatically triggers another sense, like taste or color. Many people with this condition do not realize their perception is unusual until they discover that others do not share these sensory overlaps. Experts suggest that up to four percent of the population may have synaesthesia, though many cases go undiagnosed because individuals often assume their experiences are universal.
amharic: ሲነስቲዢያ (Synaesthesia) አንድን የስሜት ህዋስ ሲነቃ ሌላኛው በራስ-ሰር የሚነቃበት ልዩ የነርቭ ሁኔታ ነው። ብዙ የዚህ ሁኔታ ተጠቂዎች ሰዎች ሁሉም ሰው እንደነሱ ስለሚሰማው፣ የራሳቸው ተሞክሮ የተለየ መሆኑን ሳያውቁ ይቆያሉ። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት እስከ አራት በመቶ የሚሆነው የዓለም ህዝብ ይህንን ሁኔታ ሊኖረው እንደሚችል እና ብዙ ሰዎች የራሳቸው ተሞክሮ ተፈጥሯዊ እንደሆነ ስለሚያስቡ ሳይመረመሩ እንደሚቀሩ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Siinaastiiziyaa (Synaesthesia) jechuun hubannoo sammuu kan namni tokko sagalee ykn waan tokko yeroo dhagahu ykn argu, miirri biraa kan akka dhandhamoo ykn bifa sammuu isaa keessatti uumamuudha. Namoonni hedduun dandeettii kana qaban, namni hundinuu akkasuma waan itti dhagahamuuf, waan haaraa ykn adda ta'e akka qaban hin beekan. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, harki afur ummata addunyaa kana qabaachuu danda'u, garuu namoonni hedduun haalli kun waan baramaa ta'eef osoo of hin qorachiisin hafu.

title: Iceland votes to reject EU accession talks: What happens next?
english: Icelandic voters have narrowly rejected a proposal to restart membership negotiations with the European Union. Although the referendum was technically non-binding, the government has committed to respecting the result, which reflects public concerns over national sovereignty and the protection of the fishing industry. This outcome halts the administration's efforts to seek closer economic and political ties with the bloc at this time.
amharic: የአይስላንድ መራጮች ከአውሮፓ ህብረት ጋር የአባልነት ድርድርን እንደገና ለመጀመር የቀረበውን ሀሳብ በትንሽ ልዩነት ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ምንም እንኳን ውጤቱ ህጋዊ አስገዳጅ ባይሆንም፣ መንግስት የህዝቡን ውሳኔ እንደሚያከብር አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የሀገሪቱን የባህር ሀብት እና ሉዓላዊነት ለመጠበቅ ባላቸው ስጋት የተነሳ፣ መንግስት ከህብረቱ ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር የነበረውን ጥረት አግዶታል።
oromo: Ummanni Ayislandi marii miseensummaa Gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin deebisanii jalqabuuf dhiyaate sagalee caalmaan didaniiru. Bu'aan kun dirqisiisaa kan hin taane ta'us, mootummaan yaada uummataa kabajuuf murteesseera. Murtoon kun kan dhufe rakkoo qabeenya qurxummii fi bilisummaa biyyattii irratti yaaddoo qaban irraa ka'uudhaan, mootummaan gamtichatti makachuuf carraaqqii taasisaa ture akka dhaabatu taasiseera.

title: Banque Misr, Egypt’s second-largest, hit by US sanctions: What to know
english: The United States is cutting off the UAE branches of Egypt’s Banque Misr from the American financial system due to allegations that the bank facilitated transactions for the Iranian government. This action is part of a broader US campaign to restrict Iran’s access to global funds and US dollars. While the bank is currently reviewing the Treasury's notice, the proposed rule would prevent its UAE operations from conducting dollar-based transactions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የግብጹ ባንክ 'ባንክ ሚስር' የተባለ ተቋም ከኢራን መንግስት ጋር የገንዘብ ልውውጥ አድርጓል በሚል በባንኩ የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬት ቅርንጫፎች ላይ ማዕቀብ ጥሏል። ይህ እርምጃ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምታደርገውን የኢኮኖሚ ጫና አካል ሲሆን ባንኩ የአሜሪካን ዶላር እና የገንዘብ ስርዓት እንዳይጠቀም ይከለክላል። የግብጹ ባንክ የዩኤስ ግምጃ ቤት የሰጠውን ማሳሰቢያ እያጠና መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa baankii Gibxii kan ta'e 'Banque Misr' qaama mootummaa Iraan waliin walitti dhufeenya maallaqaa qabaachuun himatee, dameewwan baankichaa kan UAE irratti tarkaanfii fudhateera. Tarkaanfiin kun dhiibbaa diinagdee Ameerikaan Iraan irratti gootu keessaa isa tokko yoo ta'u, baankichi sirna maallaqa Ameerikaa fi doolaara fayyadamuu akka hin dandeenye dhorka. Baankichi hubachiisa Ministeera Maallaqa Ameerikaa irraa dhufe qorachaa akka jiru beeksiseera.

title: Van Dijk wants Cody Gakpo to stay at Liverpool despite Man City interest
english: Liverpool captain Virgil van Dijk has publicly expressed his desire for teammate Cody Gakpo to remain at the club amid strong transfer interest from Manchester City. While the team is preparing for the arrival of new signing Bradley Barcola, Van Dijk emphasized Gakpo's importance to the squad and their personal friendship. Liverpool is currently considering a significant offer for the Dutch forward as they navigate a period of tactical transition under manager Andoni Iraola.
amharic: የሊቨርፑሉ ካፒቴን ቫርጂል ቫን ዳይክ የቡድን አጋሩ ኮዲ ጋክፖ በማንቸስተር ሲቲ ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት ቢታይበትም በክለቡ እንዲቆይ እንደሚፈልግ በይፋ ተናግሯል። ሊቨርፑል አዲሱን ተጫዋች ብራድሊ ባርኮላን ለማስፈረም እየተዘጋጀ ባለበት ወቅት ቫን ዳይክ የጋክፖን አስፈላጊነትና የቅርብ ወዳጅነታቸውን አጽንኦት ሰጥቷል። ክለቡ በአሰልጣኝ አንድኒ ኢራኦላ ስር አዲስ የሽግግር ወቅት ላይ እያለ ለደች ተጫዋቹ የቀረበውን ከፍተኛ የዝውውር ጥያቄ እየገመገመ ይገኛል።
oromo: Kapiteenini Liverpuul Virjil vaan Daayik, tatuttuu gubbaa koodee Gaakpoo irratti fedhii guddaan Maanchastar Siitii irraa jiraatus, taphataan kun kilabicha akka hin gadi dhiisne barbaada. Liverpuul taphataa haaraa Biraadlii Baarkoolaa fiduuf qophaa'aa jiruus, vaan Daayik gahee Gaakpoon garee keessatti qabuufi michummaa isaanii ibseera. Kilabichi qajeelchaa Andoonii Iraolaa jalatti jijjiirama irra waan jiruuf, dhiyeessii maallaqa guddaa taphata kanaaf dhiyaate irratti xiyyeeffachuutti jira.

title: Dozens of soldiers arrested after apparent coup attempt in Niger’s capital
english: Military authorities in Niger have detained dozens of soldiers following a failed attempt to overthrow the current government in Niamey. The incident occurred after a period of instability and represents a significant challenge to the nation's ruling junta. State television confirmed the arrests, signaling that the authorities have regained control of the situation.
amharic: በኒጀር ዋና ከተማ ኒያሜይ መንግስትን ለመገልበጥ ሙከራ ያደረጉ በርካታ ወታደሮች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ይህ ክስተት ሀገሪቱን የሚያስተዳድረው ወታደራዊ ቡድን ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት የደቀነ ነበር። የመንግስት የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ እንደዘገበው ከሆነ፣ ባለስልጣናት አመጹን ተቆጣጥረው ወታደሮቹን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል።
oromo: Mootummaa Nijeer irratti fonqolcha mootummaa yaalame hordofee, waraanni hedduun magaalaa guddoo Niyaameetti to'annoo jala oolaniiru. Gochi kun bulchiinsa waraanaa biyyattii irratti balaa guddaa kan uume yoo ta'u, erga jeequmsi kun uumamee booda mootummaan to'annoo isaa jabeessera. Televizhiiniin mootummaa akka gabaasetti, qabsoon kun kan fashalaa'e yoo ta'u, shakkamtoonni kunneenis seeratti dhiyaachaa jiru.

title: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
english: Swiss authorities have launched an intensive manhunt following a shooting at a techno festival in Aarau that left one 22-year-old woman dead and five others injured. The incident occurred early Sunday morning at a horse racing track where thousands had gathered for the event. Police are currently investigating the motive behind the attack and have requested public assistance as they patrol the surrounding region to locate the suspect.
amharic: በስዊዘርላንድ አራው ከተማ በተካሄደ የሙዚቃ ፌስቲቫል ላይ በተፈጸመ ተኩስ የአንዲት የ22 ዓመት ወጣት ህይወት ሲያልፍ አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፖሊስ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመውን አካል ለመያዝ ሰፊ የሆነ ፍለጋ እየካሄደ ሲሆን፣ የተኩሱ መነሻ ምክንያት እስካሁን አልታወቀም። ባለሥልጣናት የክስተቱን እውነታ ለማጣራት ከህዝቡ ምስክርነት እና መረጃዎችን እየሰበሰቡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Siwiizerlaand magaalaa Aarau keessatti qophii muuziqaa irratti dhukaasa banameen dargaggeetti umriin ishee 22 ta'e lubbuun yoo dabartu, namoonni shan ammoo miidhamaniiru. Poolisiin namicha yakka kana raawwate to'annoo jala oolchuuf sakatta'iinsa bal'aa taasisaa jiru; sababa dhukaasa kanaa hanga ammaa beekamuun isaa hin ibsamne. Abbootiin taayitaa qorannoo kana gaggeessuuf uummata irraa odeeffannoo fi ragaa barbaadaa jiru.

title: Tearful Roger Federer inducted into Tennis Hall of Fame
english: Tennis legend Roger Federer was recently inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame in Rhode Island. During an emotional ceremony, the 20-time Grand Slam champion expressed deep gratitude for his career and the sport that shaped his life. While he officially retired from professional competition in 2022, Federer emphasized that tennis remains central to his family, friendships, and future endeavors.
amharic: የቴኒስ ኮከብ ሮጀር ፌደረር በሮድ አይላንድ በሚገኘው ዓለም አቀፍ የቴኒስ ዝና አዳራሽ (Hall of Fame) ውስጥ ተካቷል። በስሜታዊነት በተሞላበት የክብር ሥነ-ሥርዓት ላይ፣ የ20 ጊዜ የግራንድ ስላም አሸናፊው ለስፖርቱ እና ለሙያ ሕይወቱ ያለውን ጥልቅ አድናቆት ገልጿል። ምንም እንኳን በ2022 ከውድድር ጡረታ ቢወጣም፣ ቴኒስ አሁንም ከቤተሰቡ፣ ከወዳጅነቱ እና ከወደፊት ህይወቱ ጋር የተሳሰረ እንደሆነ ተናግሯል።
oromo: Leenji'aan teniisi beekamaan Roojar Federer galma kabaja teniisi (International Tennis Hall of Fame) biyya Rhode Island keessatti galuun kabajameera. Sirna miira namaa tuqu kana irratti, injifataan rikoordii 'Grand Slam' 20 ta'e kun, jireenya isaa guutuu keessatti waan teniisi isaaf godheef galata guddaa galeera. Bara 2022 keessa tapha ogummaa isaa kan dhaabe ta'us, teniisi jireenya maatii isaa, michoota isaa fi fuuldura isaa keessatti iddoo guddaa qabaachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Chelsea sign Argentinian goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez from Aston Villa
english: Chelsea has officially signed Argentinian goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez from Aston Villa on a three-year contract. The 33-year-old World Cup winner joins the London club in a deal valued at approximately $10 million. Chelsea's manager, Xabi Alonso, hopes Martinez will address the team's ongoing challenges in the goalkeeper position.

title: Photos: Nepal issues alerts as region’s flash flood death toll reaches 750
english: Nepal has issued urgent flood warnings following catastrophic flash floods that have claimed 750 lives across Nepal and Tibet, with over 3,000 individuals still missing. Global partners, including the US, UK, and the UN, have pledged millions of dollars to support recovery and humanitarian relief efforts.

title: Israel says Netanyahu’s son ‘urgently evacuated’ from the US after threat
english: Israeli intelligence officials recently rushed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's son, Yair, back to Israel from his residence in Florida due to a serious security threat. While specific details remain undisclosed, reports suggest the evacuation followed an alleged Iranian plot to target him. Yair Netanyahu, who has lived in the United States for several years, returned home accompanied by his government-provided security detail.

english: In the Golo region of central Darfur, local residents are manually repairing damaged roads to allow emergency vehicles access to their community. The citizens are working by hand to move large rocks and clear paths in difficult terrain. Despite their dedicated efforts, the scale of the destruction makes the road restoration process an extremely challenging task.
amharic: በሱዳን ማዕከላዊ ዳርፉር የሚገኙ የጎሎ ነዋሪዎች የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ተሽከርካሪዎች ወደ አካባቢያቸው እንዲደርሱ የተበላሹ መንገዶችን በእጅ በመጠገን ላይ ናቸው። ነዋሪዎቹ በትልልቅ አለቶች የተዘጉ መንገዶችን ለማጽዳት ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። ሆኖም መንገዶቹ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው በመሆኑ፣ ስራው እጅግ አድካሚ እና ፈታኝ ሆኗል።
oromo: Naannoo Golo kan Suudaan, kutaa Daarfuur giddu galeessaa keessa jiran jiraattonni, konkolaattonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa akka isaan bira gahanuf jecha daandiiwwan miidhaman harka isaaniin suphuutti jiru. Jiraattonni kun dhagoota gurguddoo daandii irraa kaasuun qulqulleessuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Ta’us, miidhaan daandichaa hammaata waan ta’eef, hojiin kun baay'ee ulfaataa fi dadhabsiisaa ta'eera.

title: Venezuela says it retains ‘sovereignty’ following US oil deal
english: Venezuela has reached a significant 25-year agreement to allow the United States to develop 65 billion barrels of its oil reserves. Interim President Delcy Rodriguez emphasized that Venezuela maintains sovereignty over its natural resources while receiving $19 for every barrel sold to the US. This partnership aims to revitalize the country's struggling energy sector through foreign investment and technical expertise, potentially generating over $200 billion in annual revenue.
amharic: ቬኔዙኤላ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ኩባንያዎች የሀገሪቱን 65 ቢሊዮን በርሜል ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ለ25 ዓመታት እንዲያለሙ የሚያስችል ታሪካዊ ስምምነት ተፈራርማለች። ጊዜያዊ ፕሬዝዳንቷ ደልሲ ሮድሪጌዝ እንደገለጹት ስምምነቱ ሀገሪቱ በሀብቷ ላይ ያላትን ሉዓላዊነት እንደጠበቀች፣ ለእያንዳንዱ ለዩኤስ በሚሸጥ በርሜል ነዳጅ 19 ዶላር ገቢ የምታገኝበት ነው። ይህ አጋርነት በኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ የተዳከመውን የሀገሪቱን የነዳጅ ዘርፍ በውጭ ኢንቨስትመንት ለማነቃቃት እና በየዓመቱ ከ200 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ገቢ ለማግኘት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Venezuuelaan qabeenya ishee keessaa baareelii biliyoona 65 ta’u waggoota 25f akka misoomsuuf biyya Ameerikaa waliin walii galteerra geesseerti. Preezidaantiin yeroo Delcy Rodriguez akka ibsanitti, walii galtichi Venezuuelaan qabeenya ishee irratti aangoo fi abbummaa akka qabdu kan mirkaneessu yoo ta’u, baareelii gurguramu hunda irraa doolaara 19 isheedhaaf akka galu kan taasisuudha. Walii galtichi kun teeknoolojii fi maallaqa biyyoota alaa fayyadamuun damee anniisaa ishee kufuuf jedhu deebisanii ijaaruufi waggaatti doolaara biliyoona 200 ol argachuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Amnesty urges action after Katz likens Gaza kites to drones
english: Amnesty International has criticized Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz for labeling kites and balloons flown by children in Gaza as military drones. The Israeli government has threatened to use force to remove Palestinians from areas where these items are launched, claiming they pose a security threat to southern Israel. Human rights advocates argue this policy further deprives children of their childhood and have called on the international community to hold Israel accountable.
amharic: የአምነስቲ ኢንተርናሽናል ድርጅት የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ በጋዛ ህጻናት የሚበሩትን መንሸራተቻዎች እና ፊኛዎች እንደ ወታደራዊ ድሮን በመቁጠር የሰጡትን መግለጫ ኮንኗል። የእስራኤል መንግስት እነዚህ ነገሮች በሚለቀቁባቸው አካባቢዎች የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያንን በሃይል ለማስወጣት ማቀዱን አስታውቋል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ይህ ድርጊት የህጻናትን መብት የሚጥስ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ አለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ እስራኤልን በድርጊቷ ተጠያቂ እንዲያደርግ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa Amnesty International, Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz, ijoolleen Gaazaatti kanneen xiyyaara waraanaa (drones) akka ta'anitti lakkaa'uusaanii balaaleffateera. Mootummaan Israa'el, ijoolleen kun xiyyaaraafi bubbee qilleensa keessa oofuun fayyadamaa jiran bakka jiran irraa lammiilee Falasxiin humnaan ari'uuf karoorfateera. Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa kun, tarkaanfiin kun ijoollee gammachuu isaanii kan dhowwatuufi kan mirga isaanii sarbu ta'uu ibsuun, hawaasni addunyaa tarkaanfii Israa'el fudhachaa jirtu kana irratti gaafatamummaa akka fudhataniif waamicha dhiyeessera.

title: Israel to sign $3.6bn defence deal with Greece, its largest ever
english: Greece is set to finalize a record-breaking $3.6 billion defense agreement with Israel to bolster its aerial security. Under this deal, Israel will provide advanced technologies, including the David's Sling system and various interceptors, to protect Greece from missiles, rockets, and drones. This contract represents the most significant defense export transaction in Israeli history.
amharic: ግሪክ የአየር መከላከያ አቅሟን ለማጠናከር ከእስራኤል ጋር 3.6 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት ታሪካዊ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ልትፈራረም ነው። በዚህ ስምምነት መሰረት እስራኤል ለግሪክ ሚሳይሎችን፣ ሮኬቶችን እና ድሮኖችን መከላከል የሚያስችሉ ዘመናዊ የመከላከያ ስርዓቶችን ታቀርባለች። ይህ ስምምነት እስራኤል እስካሁን ካከናወነቻቸው የመከላከያ መሳሪያዎች ሽያጭ ትልቁ ነው።
oromo: Giriikin qophii nageenya qilleensa ishee cimsuuf jedhamuun, Israa'el waliin waligaltee ittisa biyyaa kan biiliyoona 3.6 kan ta'u mallatteessuuf jirti. Waligaltee kana keessatti, Israa'el Giriikiif meeshaalee ammayyaa kanneen akka misayila, rookeeta fi droomiiwwan ittisuu danda'an gumaachuuf murteessiteetti. Waligalteen kun seenaa Israa'el keessatti daldala meeshaalee waraanaa guddaa isaa ta'uun beekama.

title: Israeli forces, settlers killed 235 children in West Bank since 7 Oct 2023, report says
english: Since October 7, 2023, there has been a significant rise in the deaths of Palestinian children and teenagers in the West Bank due to actions by Israeli military forces and settlers. Reports indicate that over 200 minors have been killed during this period, marking a sharp increase compared to the casualty rates recorded in previous years. This surge in violence includes tragic incidents where infants and children were caught in indiscriminate fire, drawing widespread concern over their safety in the region.
amharic: ከጥቅምት 7 ቀን 2023 ጀምሮ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች ድርጊት ምክንያት በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ህጻናት እና ታዳጊዎች ሞት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል። በተጠቀሰው ጊዜ ውስጥ ከ200 በላይ ህጻናት መገደላቸው የተነገረ ሲሆን ይህም ካለፉት ዓመታት ጋር ሲነጻጸር እጅግ ከፍተኛ ጭማሪ አሳይቷል። ይህ የጥቃት መስፋፋት ህጻናት ያለምንም ልዩነት በተከፈተ ተኩስ ለህልፈት የተዳረጉባቸውን አሳዛኝ ሁኔታዎች ያካተተ ሲሆን ጉዳዩ በክልሉ ውስጥ ያለውን የህጻናት ደህንነት ስጋት ላይ ጥሏል።
oromo: Muddee 7, 2023 irraa eegalee, gocha humnoota waraana Israa'elii fi qotee bulaa Israa'elii kanaan walqabatee daa'immanii fi dargaggoonni Falasxiin biyya West Bank keessatti ajjeefamuun isaanii guddachaa dhufeera. Gabaasni akka agarsiisutti, yeroo kana keessatti daa'imman 200 ol ta'an ajjeefamuu isaanii fi kunis waggoota darban waliin yoo madaalamu daballi guddaa akka qabu ibsameera. Jireenya daa'immanii irratti balaan kun, daa'imman rasaasa iddoo tokko hin jedhamneen miidhamuu isaanii kan dabalatu ta'uun, tasgabbii fi nageenya daa'immanii ilaalchisee yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Israeli forces close entrance to West Bank village while settlers steal sheep
english: Israeli military forces have blocked the main entrance to the village of al-Mughayyir in the occupied West Bank for over 20 hours. During a recent raid, armed settlers and soldiers attacked local residents and obstructed medical aid from reaching three injured individuals. Reports indicate that the settlers also stole 15 lambs, a move local officials believe is part of a broader effort to force Palestinians to leave the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ በሚገኘው አል-ሙጋይር መንደር መግቢያ ላይ ከ20 ሰዓታት በላይ ዘግተውታል። በቅርቡ በተፈጸመ ወረራ ወቅት የታጠቁ ሰፋሪዎችና ወታደሮች የአካባቢውን ነዋሪዎች በማጥቃት የተጎዱ ሰዎችን የህክምና እርዳታ እንዳያገኙ ከልክለዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ 15 በጎችን የሰረቁ ሲሆን፣ የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርጊት ፍልስጤማውያንን ከቀያቸው ለማፈናቀል የተደረገ ሙከራ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el balbala guddaa baadiyyaa Al-Mughayyir kan Zoonii Qabamee jiru keessatti argamu sa'aatii 20 ol cufanii turaniiru. Raayyaa dhiheenya kana raawwatameen, qotee bulaa fi waraanni jiraattota naannichaa haleelanii, namoota miidhaan irra ga'eef gargaarsi yaala fayyaa akka hin geenye dhorkaniiru. Qotee bulaan kunneen hoolota 15 hatanii kan deeman yoo ta'u, hoogganoonni naannichaa tarkaanfiin kun namoota Falasxiin biyyasaanii akka gadhiisan dirqisiisuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Egypt, Kuwait urge return to US-Iran negotiations, de-escalation
english: The foreign ministers of Egypt and Kuwait recently spoke by phone to address the growing tensions between Iran and the United States. They emphasized the importance of returning to diplomatic dialogue, citing a previous memorandum of understanding as a foundation for future talks. Both leaders stressed that cooling regional conflict is a priority to ensure long-term stability in the area.
amharic: የግብፅ እና የኩዌት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል እየጨመረ የመጣውን ውጥረት በተመለከተ በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። ሁለቱ ወገኖች ቀደም ሲል የተፈረመውን የመግባቢያ ስምምነት በመጠቀም ወደ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግሮች መመለስ እንደሚያስፈልግ አሳስበዋል። በክልሉ ዘላቂ ሰላም እና መረጋጋት ለማምጣት ውጥረትን መቀነስ ቅድሚያ የሚሰጠው ጉዳይ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimmi alaa Masrii fi Kuweyt walitti dhufeenya biyyoota Iraanii fi Ameerikaa gidduutti cimaa dhufe ilaalchisee bilbilaan mari'ataniiru. Hoggantoonni kunneen furmaata nagaa fi mariin biyyoota lamaan gidduutti akka deebi'uuf walii galaniiru. Tasgabbii naannichaa eeguuf jecha, kutaaleen wal-dhaban hundi gara mariitti deebi'uun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Fed Now Repays Its Bills with More Bills
english: The federal government is increasingly financing its debt by issuing new Treasury bills to pay off maturing ones. Despite a significant drop in interest yields, investor demand for these government securities remains exceptionally high. This strategy reflects a growing trend of relying on short-term debt cycles to manage national fiscal obligations.
amharic: የፌደራል መንግሥት የቆዩ ዕዳዎችን ለመክፈል አዳዲስ የትሬዠሪ ቦንዶችን በመሸጥ ላይ ይገኛል። የወለድ ምጣኔው በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ የቀነሰ ቢሆንም፣ ባለሀብቶች በእነዚህ የመንግሥት የዕዳ ሰነዶች ላይ ያላቸው ፍላጎት እጅግ በጣም ከፍተኛ ነው። ይህ አካሄድ መንግሥት የፊስካል ግዴታዎቹን ለመወጣት በአጭር ጊዜ የዕዳ ዑደት ላይ መታመኑን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan federaalaa liqii isaa kaffaluuf gatii liqii haaraa baasuudhaan kan duraanii kaffalaa jira. Gatiin dhala liqii gadi bu'us, fedhiin invastorootaa liqii mootummaa kana irratti qaban baay'ee ol aanaa dha. Haalli kun mootummaan dirqama maallaqa isaa bahuuf liqii gabaabaa irratti hirkachuu isaa kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Between Tax Authorities, Dealers, Buyers Who Cannot Keep Up
english: The Addis Abeba City Revenue Bureau has ordered car dealers and brokers to clear their vehicles from prominent sales lots within three days. This sudden directive has caused many well-known car-selling areas across the city to become largely deserted. Both car sellers and prospective buyers are now facing significant challenges as a result of these new enforcement measures.

Ajajni kun bakkeewwan konkolaataan itti gurguramu hedduu akka duwwaa ta'an taasiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun gurgurtotaa fi bitattota konkolaataa irratti dhiibbaa uumuun rakkoo guddaa keessa galcheera.

title: Judges Set Auction Price for D’Afrique Its Owners Claim Worth Five Times More
english: The Federal High Court has ordered the auction of the historic D’Afrique Hotel in Addis Ababa to resolve a long-standing inheritance dispute among the heirs of its late owner. While the court has set an initial bid price of approximately 184 million Birr for the September auction, the owners argue this figure is far below the hotel's actual value. The proceeds from the sale will be divided among the heirs, ending two decades of legal conflict regarding the property.
amharic: የፌደራል ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት የሟቹ ባለቤት ወራሾች በአዲስ አበባ በሚገኘው ታሪካዊው ዲ አፍሪካ ሆቴል ላይ ሲያደርጉት የነበረውን የሃያ ዓመት የውርስ ክርክር ለመፍታት ሆቴሉ በጨረታ እንዲሸጥ ወስኗል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ለሴፕቴምበር ወር ለታቀደው ጨረታ መነሻ ዋጋውን ወደ 184 ሚሊዮን ብር ገድቦታል፤ ነገር ግን የሆቴሉ ባለቤቶች ይህ ዋጋ ከእውነተኛው የገበያ ዋጋ በአምስት እጥፍ ያነሰ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ይቃወማሉ። ከጨረታው የሚገኘው ገንዘብ በወራሾቹ መካከል ይከፋፈላል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa federaalaatti, hordoffii walitti bu'iinsa dhaala qabeenyaa waggaa digdamii tokkoof gaggeeffamaa ture booda, hoteelli seena-qabeessi D'Afrique magaalaa Finfinnee keessatti argamu akka gurguramu ajajeera. Mana murtichaa gatiin ka'umsaa hoteelichaa birrii miliyoona 184 ta'ee akka gurguramu murteessus, abbootin qabeenyaa gatiin kun gatii sirrii qabeenyichaa kan gadi aanaa ta'uu ibsanii mormaniiru. Gatiin gurgurtaa argamu kunis waldhabdee waggaa digdamii turre xumuruuf walduraa duubaan dhaaltota gidduutti qooddama.

title: Revenue Ministry Wants to See Each Business Line Separately Filed
english: The Ethiopian Ministry of Revenues is requiring medium-sized businesses to submit comprehensive financial reports through its digital platform. Taxpayers must now provide detailed documents including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow records for every aspect of their operations. This initiative is designed to give the government a deeper and more transparent understanding of individual business activities.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር መካከለኛ ገቢ ያላቸው ንግዶች ዝርዝር የገንዘብ ሪፖርታቸውን በዲጂታል ስርዓታቸው አማካኝነት እንዲያቀርቡ አዟል። ታክስ ከፋዮች የገቢ መግለጫዎችን፣ የሂሳብ ሚዛኖችን እና የጥሬ ገንዘብ ዝውውር መረጃዎችን ጨምሮ ስለ ንግድ ስራቸው ዝርዝር መረጃ እንዲያቀርቡ ይጠበቃል። ይህ እርምጃ መንግስት የንግድ ተቋማትን እንቅስቃሴ በዝርዝር እና በግልጽ ለመከታተል ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri Galiiwwan Itoophiyaa daldaltoota giddu-galeessaa ta’an hundi gabaasa isaanii kan herregaa sirna dijitaalaa isaaniin akka dhiyeessan ajajeera. Daldaltoonni kun gabaasa galii, madaala herregaa fi odiitii maallaqaa dabalatee hojii isaanii waliin walqabatu hunda ifatti ibsuun irraa eegama. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan hojii daldalaa irratti hubannoo guutuu fi iftoomina qabu akka argatuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Ethiopia’s Power Halved Djibouti’s Bills, Gazes at a Bigger Market
english: A recent World Bank report highlights that Ethiopian electricity exports have successfully reduced Djibouti's power generation costs by half. During the 2024/25 period, Ethiopia generated over 118 million dollars in revenue through energy sales to Kenya, Djibouti, Sudan, and Tanzania. The report also identifies a developing energy corridor between Ethiopia, Kenya, and Tanzania as a vital step toward creating a unified electricity market in Africa.
amharic: የዓለም ባንክ ባወጣው አዲስ ሪፖርት መሠረት፣ ከኢትዮጵያ የሚገኘው የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል የጅቡቲን የኃይል ማመንጫ ወጪ በግማሽ እንዲቀንስ አስችሏል። በ2017 ዓ.ም የኢትዮጵያ ኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል ለኬንያ፣ ለጅቡቲ፣ ለሱዳን እና ለታንዛኒያ የኃይል ሽያጭ በማካሄድ ከ118 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ገቢ አግኝቷል። ሪፖርቱ በኢትዮጵያ፣ በኬንያ እና በታንዛኒያ መካከል እየተፈጠረ ያለው የኃይል ማስተላለፊያ መስመር የአፍሪካን የጋራ የኤሌክትሪክ ገበያ ለመፍጠር ትልቅ ሚና እንደሚጫወት አመላክቷል።
oromo: Gabaasni Baanki Addunyaa haaraan akka ibsetti, ibsi annisaa Itoophiyaarraa argamu baasii omisha humna ibsaa Jibuutii harka walakkaan hir’iseera. Itoophiyaan bara 2017 keessa Keeniyaa, Jibuutii, Sudaanii fi Tanzaaniyaaf ibsaa gurguruudhaan doolaara miiliyoona 118 ol argatteetti. Gabaasni kun, walitti hidhiinsi humna ibsaa Itoophiyaa, Keeniyaa fi Tanzaaniyaa gidduutti jalqabame, gabaa ibsaa Afrikaa tokko ta’e uumuuf tarkaanfii barbaachisaa ta’uu ibseera.

title: Israeli settlers attack international news team in occupied West Bank
english: A group of masked Israeli settlers physically assaulted an NBC news crew and a Palestinian woman near the West Bank village of Jalud. The journalists were documenting the woman's story after she was forced to leave her home due to settler violence. Both the reporting team and the woman sustained injuries during this unprovoked attack.
amharic: ጭምብል ያደረጉ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በምዕራብ ባንክ ጃሉድ መንደር አቅራቢያ በኤንቢሲ የዜና ቡድን እና በአንዲት ፍልስጤማዊት ሴት ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። የዜና ቡድኑ ሴትየዋ ከቤቷ በሰፋሪዎች መፈናቀሏን ተከትሎ ቃለ መጠይቅ እያደረጉ ነበር። በዚህ ድንገተኛ ጥቃት የዜና ቡድኑ አባላት እና ሴትየዋ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Gareen jiraattota Israa'el fuula isaanii haguugatan, naannoo baadiyaa Jalud kan Qarqara Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti garee oduu NBC fi dubartii Falasxiin tokko irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Gareen oduu kun dubartii tana, erga jiraattotaan mana ishee irraa buqqaatee booda haala ishee gaafachaa turan. Humni haleellaa kana raawwate kun gaazexeessotaa fi dubartittii irratti miidhaa qaamaa geessiseera.

title: Spectacular fireworks over Damascus as ‘Syria Shines Again’
english: The Syrian capital of Damascus recently celebrated the return of the Damascus International Fair with a vibrant fireworks display. This 63rd edition of the event is held under the theme 'Syria Shines Again.' It marks the first time the fair has taken place following the end of Bashar al-Assad's rule.
amharic: የሶሪያ ዋና ከተማ ደማስቆ የደማስቆ ዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ ትርኢት መመለስን በደማቅ የርችት ዝግጅት አክብራለች። የዘንድሮው የንግድ ትርኢት ለ63ኛ ጊዜ 'ሶሪያ እንደገና ታበራለች' በሚል መሪ ቃል ነው የተካሄደው። ይህ ዝግጅት የባሻር አል-አሳድ አገዛዝ ካበቃ በኋላ የተካሄደ የመጀመሪያው የንግድ ትርኢት ነው።
oromo: Magalaan guddoon Suuriyaa, Damaasqoon, agarsiisa gurguddaa idil-addunyaa kan Damaasqoo deebi'ee banamuu isaa ibsuuf bifa babbareedaan dhukaatii daayii fayyadamuun kabajdeetti. Agarsiisni kun yeroo 63ffaaf 'Suuriyaan ammas ni ifti' jedhuun kan gaggeeffame yoo ta'u, kunis erga bulchiinsi Bashaar Al-Asaad xumuramee booda qophiin kun yeroo jalqabaaf kan godhame dha.

title: Voting closes in Iceland’s knife-edge EU referendum
english: Iceland has concluded its closely contested referendum on whether to restart negotiations for European Union membership. Because polls show the nation is almost evenly divided on the issue, officials expect a tight race with results coming in late. The government has committed to following the public's decision, which could lead to years of formal talks with the EU if voters approve.
amharic: አይስላንድ ወደ አውሮፓ ህብረት ለመቀላቀል የሚደረገውን ድርድር እንደገና ስለመጀመር በጉጉት ሲጠበቅ የነበረውን ህዝበ ውሳኔ አጠናቃለች። የሕዝብ አስተያየት መጠይቆች እንደሚያሳዩት ድምፁ እጅግ የተጠጋጋ በመሆኑ ውጤቱ በውል ለመታወቅ የተወሰነ ጊዜ ሊወስድ ይችላል። መንግሥት የሕዝቡን ውሳኔ እንደሚያከብር የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ አዎ የሚለው ድምፅ ካሸነፈ አገሪቱ ከህብረቱ ጋር ረጅም ዓመታት ሊፈጅ የሚችል ድርድር ትጀምራለች።

Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti ummanni waan wal qixxaateef bu'aan isaa haalaan kan wal morkatu ta'a jedhamee eegama. Mootummaan murtee ummataa akka kabajuu fi yaanni 'eeyyee' jedhu yoo injifate, biyyattiin gamtichaa wajjin marii waggoota dheeraa fudhachuu danda'u tokko akka jalqabdu beekameera.

title: Ukrainian nuclear power plant without external power for over a week
english: The Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant in Ukraine has been operating without its primary external power source for over a week, forcing it to rely on backup diesel generators. This facility, which is the largest of its kind in Europe, must maintain power to keep its reactors cool and prevent a potential disaster. International regulators are currently attempting to arrange a ceasefire so that workers can repair the damaged electrical lines.
amharic: በዩክሬን የሚገኘው የዛፖሪዢያ የኑክሌር ኃይል ማመንጫ ጣቢያ ከሳምንት በላይ ከዋናው የኤሌክትሪክ መስመር ተቋርጦ በድንገተኛ የናፍታ ጀነሬተሮች እየሰራ ይገኛል። በአውሮፓ ትልቁ የሆነው ይህ ማዕከል የኑክሌር መቅለጥ አደጋ እንዳይከሰት ሬአክተሮቹን ማቀዝቀዝ ያስፈልገዋል። አለም አቀፍ የኑክሌር ተቆጣጣሪዎች የተበላሹ የኤሌክትሪክ መስመሮችን ለመጠገን የሚያስችል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ለመፍጠር እየሞከሩ ነው።

title: Ontario’s Doug Ford prods Trump with sign rejecting ‘Lake America’ name
english: Ontario Premier Doug Ford recently installed a sign near Lake Ontario to formally reject President Donald Trump's executive order renaming the body of water 'Lake America.' This action highlights the growing political tension between Canada and the United States amidst an escalating trade war. Ford stated the sign serves as a permanent reminder that the lake's identity will remain unchanged regardless of current political disputes.
amharic: የኦንታሪዮ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዳግ ፎርድ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኦንታሪዮ ሐይቅን ስም ወደ 'አሜሪካ ሐይቅ' ለመቀየር ያወጡትን ትዕዛዝ በመቃወም በሐይቁ አቅራቢያ ምልክት አቁመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በካናዳ እና በአሜሪካ መካከል እየተካረረ የመጣውን የንግድ ጦርነት ተከትሎ የተፈጠረውን የፖለቲካ ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው። ፎርድ ምልክቱ የሐይቁ ስም በፖለቲካዊ አለመግባባቶች ሳይቀየር ለዘላለም ኦንታሪዮ ተብሎ እንደሚጠራ ለማስታወስ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Ontario Doug Ford, pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp maqaa 'Haroo Ontario' gara 'Haroo Ameerikaa' jijjiiruuf ajaja baasan mormuun haroo sana biratti mallattoo dhaabaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun daldala biyyoota lamaan gidduutti jalqabame hordofee walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa jiru agarsiisa. Ford mallattoon kun maqaan haroo kanaa mormii siyaasaa kamiyyuu malee 'Haroo Ontario' jedhamee kan itti fufu ta'uu akka yaadachiisu ibsaniiru.

title: Palestinian injured in Israeli strike on Khan Younis succumbs, report says
english: A Palestinian individual has died following injuries from an Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis. This fatality brings the total number of deaths from recent attacks in Gaza to three. Previous reports indicated that two others were killed in a separate drone strike in Gaza City.

oromo: Namni Falasxiin tokko weerara xiyyaara Israa'eel kan Kaani Yuunisitti raawwatameen miidhamuun erga yaalamaa turee booda lubbuun isaa darbeera. Duuti kun lakkoofsi namoota weerara kana kanaan du'anii gara sadiitti akka ol guddatu godheera. Kanaan dura, magaalattiitti weerara xiyyaara nama maleeyyiin (drone) namoonni lama ajjeefamuun isaanii gabaasamee ture.

title: Israeli forces shoot at girl, two young men in Gaza
english: Israeli military forces have conducted multiple attacks across the Gaza Strip, resulting in injuries to several civilians, including a child and a young girl. The incidents involved direct gunfire in areas such as Jabalia, Al-Tuam, and Al-Bureij, alongside artillery strikes targeting the northwest section of Rafah. These operations highlight the ongoing violence impacting various regions throughout the territory.

oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'eel qaamolee gaza gara garaatti haleellaa geggeessaniin ijoollee dabalatee namoonni nagaa hedduun miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun bakkeewwan akka Jabaliyaa, Al-Tuwaamii fi Al-Bureeyjitti dhukaasa kallattii fi akkasumas kibba-lixaa magaalaa Raafaahitti dhukaasa madafii kan dabalatu ture. Gochotni kunneen naannichatti waraanni kun babal'achaa fi haala sodaachisaa keessa akka jiru agarsiisu.

title: 'Liar, liar, pants on fire': Ghalibaf mocks US treasury secretary over fuel claims
english: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf publicly ridiculed US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent for his recent assertions regarding oil shipment statistics. Ghalibaf dismissed the claims as dishonest and referenced a critical article by economist Paul Krugman to question the official's credibility. Furthermore, he criticized the current state of US financial markets and rising national war expenses.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ ስለ ነዳጅ ጭነት አሃዞች የሰጡትን መግለጫ በመቃወም የአሜሪካውን የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንትን በይፋ ተችተዋል። ጋሊባፍ የጸሐፊውን የሥራ ብቃት ለመጠራጠር የኢኮኖሚ ባለሙያውን ፖል ክሩግማንን አስተያየት እንደ ማስረጃ ተጠቅመዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ የአሜሪካን የገንዘብ ገበያ ሁኔታ እና ከፍተኛ የሆነውን የጦርነት ወጪ በመተቸት የመንግስትን መረጃዎች ውድቅ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iran Muhammad Baagir Gaalibaf, ministirri maallaqaa Amerikaa Iskootti Beesent odeeffannoo ergaa boba'aa irratti kennan dhugaa miti jechuun cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Gaalibaf amanamummaa ministirichaa shakkuuf, yaada guddina dinagdee beekaa ta'an Pool Kiruugman fayyadameera. Kana malees, dinagdee Amerikaa fi baasii waraanaa irratti dhiibbaa jiru kaasuun, ibsa ministirichaa kijiba jechuun cimsanii falmaniiru.

title: Israel would strike Iran even with a US deal, minister says
english: Israeli Energy Minister Eli Cohen stated that Israel reserves the right to attack Iran if the country attempts to advance its nuclear or missile capabilities. He emphasized that these actions would occur even if Tehran enters into a formal agreement with the United States. Cohen noted that past Israeli interventions have successfully delayed Iran's nuclear progress by several years.
amharic: የእስራኤል የኢነርጂ ሚኒስትር ኤሊ ኮሄን እንደተናገሩት፣ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ወይም የሚሳኤል ፕሮግራሟን ለማራመድ ብትሞክር እስራኤል ጥቃት እንደምትሰነዝር አስታውቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ኢራን ከአሜሪካ ጋር ስምምነት ብትፈጽምም እንኳ እንደሚቀጥል ሚኒስትሩ አሳስበዋል። ከዚህ ቀደም የተደረጉ የእስራኤል ጣልቃ ገብነቶች የኢራንን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራም ለተወሰኑ ዓመታት ማዘግየታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Inaarjii Israa'el Elii Koheen, Iraan sagantaa niwukilaraa ykn misaa'elaa ishee cimsuuf yaaltu yoo ta'e, Israa'el tarkaanfii waraanaa akka fudhattu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun Iraan Ameerikaa waliin walii galtee irra gaatte illee kan hin dhiisne ta'uu ministirichi hubachiisaniiru. Duraan tarkaanfiin Israa'el fudhatte sagantaa niwukilaraa Iraan waggoota muraasaan akka dheeratu taasiseera jedhan.

title: Israeli settlers attack NBC News team, wound Palestinian woman near Nablus
english: A group of masked Israeli settlers attacked an NBC News crew and a local Palestinian woman during an interview in the village of Jalud near Nablus. The attackers used sticks and rocks to assault the journalists and the woman, resulting in injuries and damage to the crew's equipment and vehicle. The victims were targeted while documenting the impact of ongoing settler violence in the occupied West Bank.
amharic: ጭምብል ያደረጉ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በናብሉስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው ጃሉድ መንደር ውስጥ የኤንቢሲ ዜና ቡድንን እና አንድ የፍልስጤም ሴትን አጠቁ። ጥቃት አድራሾቹ በዱላ እና በድንጋይ በመጠቀም በጋዜጠኞቹ እና በሴትየዋ ላይ ጉዳት ያደረሱ ሲሆን የጋዜጠኞቹን መሳሪያዎች እና ተሽከርካሪም ሰብረዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው ቡድኑ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የሰፈራ ሰሪዎች ጥቃት እየዘገቡ በነበረበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: gareen namoota fuula isaanii haguugatan, naannoo Naablusitti argamtu gandatti, garee oduu NBC fi dubartii Falasxiinii tokko irratti haleellaa raawwatan. Haleellaa kanaan namoota oduu qindeessan irratti miidhaan qaamaa kan gahe yoo ta'u, meeshaaleen hojii fi konkolaataan isaaniis manca'aniiru. Gareen kun haleellaa jabaataa jiru kana erga qoratanii booda, haleellaan kun ganda sana keessatti rakkoo uumamaa jiru ibsuuf kan hojjetamaa ture keessatti kan raawwatame dha.

title: Anger mounts in Nepal over the government’s response to flash flood
english: Residents in Nepal's Nuwakot district are expressing significant frustration over the government's sluggish reaction to a recent, destructive flash flood near the Tibetan border. Survivors claim that authorities have been slow to provide essential humanitarian aid and to locate individuals who remain missing. The growing anger highlights the urgent need for a more effective emergency response in the devastated region.
amharic: በኔፓል ኑዋኮት ወረዳ ነዋሪዎች ከቲቤት ድንበር አቅራቢያ በደረሰው የጎርፍ አደጋ ምክንያት የመንግሥት ምላሽ ዘግይቷል በማለት ቅሬታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው። የተረፉት ሰዎች መንግሥት አስፈላጊውን ሰብአዊ ድጋፍ ለማቅረብ እና የጠፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ ያሳየው መዘግየት እንዳሳዘናቸው ገልጸዋል። ይህ እየጨመረ የመጣው ህዝባዊ ቁጣ፣ በተጎዳው አካባቢ ፈጣን እና ውጤታማ የአደጋ ጊዜ እርዳታ እንደሚያስፈልግ አመላካች ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Nuwaakoottii kan Nipaalitti, uummatni balaa lolaa daangaa Tibetiin dhihoo jiruun gahuu hordofee tarkaanfii mootummaan fudhateef baay'ee gadduu fi aaruu ibsachaa jira. Namoonni balaa kanaan miidhaman akka jedhanitti, mootummaan gargaarsa namoomaa fi namoota dhabaman barbaaduu irratti baay'ee suuta jedheera. Aariin kunis naannicha miidhametti tajaajila hatattamaa fi bu'a qabeessa ta'e kennuun barbaachisaa ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Iceland votes in a tight race on whether to resume talks to join the EU
english: Icelanders are heading to the polls to decide whether the nation should restart formal negotiations to become a member of the European Union. This referendum follows a thirteen-year pause in the country's efforts to join the bloc. The outcome remains uncertain as the race is currently very close.
amharic: የአይስላንድ ህዝብ አገሪቱ የአውሮፓ ህብረትን ለመቀላቀል የምታደርገውን ንግግር እንደገና ማስጀመር እንዳለባት ለመወሰን በምርጫ እየተሳተፈ ነው። ይህ ህዝበ ውሳኔ የተካሄደው ሀገሪቱ ወደ ህብረቱ ለመግባት ታደርግ የነበረውን ጥረት ካቆመች አስራ ሶስት አመታት በኋላ ነው። የውጤቱ ሁኔታ በአሁኑ ወቅት እጅግ አወዛጋቢ እና የቅርብ ፉክክር ያለበት ሆኗል።
oromo: Uummanni Isilaandi biyyattiin miseensa Gamtaa Awurooppaa ta'uuf marii irra deebi'ee akka eegaluuf filannoo irratti hirmaachaa jira. Kuni kan ta'e biyyattiin waggoota kudha sadii dura marii miseensummaa addaan kuttee erga turtee booda. Bu'aan filannoo kanaa ammatti kan hin beekamne yoo ta'u, dorgommii cimaa keessa jira.

title: Norway’s new king pays tribute to his late father as the country mourns
english: Norway's new monarch, King Haakon VIII, has officially assumed the throne following the death of his 89-year-old father, King Harald. In his inaugural address, the new king honored his father's legacy and pledged his commitment to serving the Norwegian people through democratic values. As the nation observes a period of official mourning, thousands of citizens have gathered in Oslo to pay their respects to the late leader.
amharic: የኖርዌይ አዲሱ ንጉስ ሃኮን ስምንተኛ የአባታቸውን የንጉስ ሃራልድን ህልፈት ተከትሎ በይፋ ስልጣኑን ተረክበዋል። ንጉሱ በመጀመሪያ ንግግራቸው የአባታቸውን መልካም ስራ በማስታወስ ለሀገሪቱ ህዝብ እና ለዲሞክራሲያዊ እሴቶች ያላቸውን ቁርጠኝነት ገልጸዋል። መላው የኖርዌይ ህዝብ በሀዘን ላይ ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ዜጎች በኦስሎ በሚገኘው የንጉሳዊ ቤተ መንግስት በመገኘት ለሟቹ ንጉስ የመጨረሻ ክብር እየሰጡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootichi haaraan biyya Norweey, Mooti Haakon VIII, erga abbaan isaanii Mooti Harald duʼaniin booda aangoo qabataniiru. Mootichi haaraan haasaa jalqabaa taasisaniin abbaan isaanii biyyaaf tajaajila gaarii kennuu isaanii yaadachuu fi saba Norweey tajaajiluuf waadaa galaniiru. Biyyi sun gadda keessa waan jirtuuf, lammiileen kumaatamaan lakkaaʼaman magaalaa Oosloo keessatti walitti qabamuun mooticha darbeef kabaja isaanii ibsachaa jiru.

title: Gaza runs out of cancer medicines, as Israeli strikes continue
english: Gaza is currently facing a total shortage of cancer medications, leaving patients without access to essential life-saving treatments. This crisis worsened after Israeli military strikes hit Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, damaging critical laboratory equipment and storage facilities. Healthcare authorities report that the ongoing violence has completely disrupted the medical supply chain in the region.
amharic: በጋዛ የካንሰር መድኃኒቶች ሙሉ በሙሉ በማለቁ በሽተኞች ሕይወት አድን ሕክምና ማግኘት ተስኗቸዋል። ችግሩ የተባባሰው እስራኤል በአል-አቅሳ ሰማዕታት ሆስፒታል ላይ ባደረሰችው ጥቃት የላቦራቶሪ ቁሳቁሶች እና የመድኃኒት ማከማቻዎች በመጎዳታቸው ነው። የጤና ባለስልጣናት እንደገለፁት፣ ቀጥተኛው ወታደራዊ ግጭት በክልሉ የነበረውን የሕክምና አቅርቦት ሰንሰለት አቋርጦታል።
oromo: Gaazaatti qorichi kaansarii guutummaatti waan dhumateef, dhukkubsattoonni yaala lubbuu baraaru argachuu hin dandeenye. Rakkoon kun kan hammaate erga waraanni Israa'el hospitaala Al-Aqsaa irratti haleellaa raawwatee booda, meeshaaleen laaboraatorii fi bakkeewwan qoricha itti kuusan miidhamanii dha. Abbootiin taayitaa fayyaa akka ibsanitti, waraanni itti fufuun isaa dhiyeessii yaala naannichaa guutummaatti addaan kutee jira.

title: Algeria wildfire death toll expected to rise as survivors say nothing left
english: Severe wildfires in northeastern Algeria have resulted in at least 12 deaths, a figure that officials expect to increase as the situation unfolds. Thousands of residents are currently struggling against the flames, which have been fueled by intense heat and dry conditions. Many survivors have reported the total destruction of their homes and villages, leaving them with nothing.
amharic: በአልጄሪያ ሰሜን ምስራቃዊ ክፍል በተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የደን ቃጠሎ ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ የሟቾች ቁጥርም ሊጨምር እንደሚችል ተሰግቷል። እጅግ ከፍተኛ የሆነ ሙቀትና ድርቅ የቃጠሎውን አደጋ ያባባሰው ሲሆን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች ከእሳት ጋር እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ። በርካታ የተረፉ ሰዎች ቤቶቻቸውና መተዳደሪያቸው ሙሉ በሙሉ በመውደሙ አንዳችም ነገር እንዳልቀረላቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Baha Kaaba Aljeeriyaatti ibidda bosonaa ka'een lubbuun namoota 12 galaafatameera, lakkoofsis ni dabala jedhamee eegama. Hoo'i cimaafi gogiinsi ibidda kana hammaachisee jiraattoota kumaatamaa rakkoo keessa buuseera. Namoonni oolaniis manneeniifi qabeenyis isaanii guutummaatti barbadaa'uu ibsuun, harkatti qabatan tokkollee akka hin hafne dubbatu.

title: Hormuz remains closed until US military actions end, Iran says
english: Iran has officially declared that the Strait of Hormuz will stay shut until the United States stops its military activities and meets specific demands. The Iranian Revolutionary Guards dismissed American assertions that the waterway is currently accessible, labeling those claims as deceptive. Tehran noted that while they have discussed passage arrangements with Oman, the reopening of the strait remains entirely dependent on American compliance.
amharic: ኢራን የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን መተላለፊያ አሜሪካ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዋን እስካላቆመች እና የተወሰኑ ግዴታዎቿን እስካላሟላች ድረስ ዝግ ሆኖ እንደሚቆይ አስታውቃለች። የአሜሪካ የባህር ወሽመጥ ክፍት ነው የሚለውን መግለጫ የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኞች ውድቅ አድርገውታል። ምንም እንኳን ኢራን ከኦማን ጋር ስለ መተላለፊያ ሁኔታዎች ተወያይታ ቢሆንም፣ የስትሬቱ መከፈት በአሜሪካ ድርጊት ላይ የተመሰረተ እንደሆነ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Iiraan karaa galaana Ormuz hanga Ameerikaan hojii waraanaa ishee dhaabdeefi dirqama ishee baatteetti cufaa akka ta'u beeksisiteetti. Eegdonni naannoo Iiraan, ibsa Ameerikaan daandiin kun banamaa dha jettee baaste dhugaa akka hin taane dubbataniiru. Iiraan Oomaan wajjin haala darbiinsa irratti mari'atus, deebi'ee banamuun daandichaa guutummaatti murtoo Ameerikaan fudhattu irratti kan hundaa'e ta'u ibsiteetti.

title: UAE central bank to inspect Banque Misr branches after US sanctions
english: The United Arab Emirates Central Bank has announced an immediate investigation into local branches of Banque Misr. This action follows a decision by the United States to block the bank from its financial system due to alleged connections to Iran. The UAE regulatory authority will conduct a thorough review of the bank's past transactions to ensure compliance with international rules.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች ማዕከላዊ ባንክ በባንክ ሚስር ቅርንጫፎች ላይ አጣዳፊ ምርመራ እንደሚያደርግ አስታውቋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው አሜሪካ ባንኩ ከኢራን ጋር ባለው ግንኙነት ምክንያት የአሜሪካን የፋይናንስ ሥርዓት እንዳይጠቀም ከከለከለች በኋላ ነው። የኤሚሬቶች የቁጥጥር አካል፣ ባንኩ ዓለም አቀፍ ደንቦችን መከተሉን ለማረጋገጥ ያለፉ ግብይቶቹን በጥልቀት ይመረምራል።
oromo: Baankiin giddu galeessaa biyya UAE dameewwan Baankii Misr irratti qorannoo ariifachiisaa geggeessuuf murteesseera. Tarkaanfichi kan fudhatame, Ameerikaan baankichi Iran wajjin walitti dhufeenya qaba jechuun sirna faayinaansii ishee irraa erga uggurtee booda. Qaamni kun seera idil-addunyaa kabajamuu isaa mirkaneeffachuuf, gochaalee baankichi kanaan dura raawwate hunda qulqulleeffata.

title: Netanyahu condemns Qusra settler attacks, calling them ‘criminal acts of violence’
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has publicly denounced recent violent attacks by settlers against Palestinian residents in the West Bank villages of Qusra and Jalud. While Netanyahu labeled these actions as criminal, reports from local residents indicate that Israeli security forces also used tear gas against Palestinians during the confrontations. The military stated they are working to stop the unrest, though accounts of their conduct remain conflicted.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ እና ጃሉድ መንደሮች በሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ድርጊቱን የወንጀል ድርጊት ሲሉ ቢገልጹም፣ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ግን የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በግጭቱ ወቅት በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ የለቅሶ ጭስ እንደተጠቀሙ ተናግረዋል። እስራኤል ግጭቱን ለማስቆም እየሰራች እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ የተፈጠረው ክስተት ግን እርስ በርሱ የሚጋጩ ዘገባዎችን አስከትሏል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun haleellaa qe'ee qabattonni baadiyaa Qusraa fi Jaaluud keessatti namoota Paalesxineerratti raawwatan balaaleffataniiru. Netanyaahuun gocha kana yakka cimaa jedhanii ibsanus, jiraattonni naannichaa garuu waraanni Israa'el walitti bu'iinsa sana keessatti namoota Paalesxineerratti gaazii imimmaanii fayyadamuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Israa'el jeequmsa kana dhaabsisuuf yaalii gochaa jirra jedhus, ibsi mootummichaa fi odeeffannoon jiraattotaa garaagarummaa qaba.

title: Southern Lebanon hit by new wave of Israeli attacks
english: Israeli forces launched a series of airstrikes and artillery bombardments across southern Lebanon on Saturday evening, targeting residential areas and a care home for the elderly in Hula. Various locations were struck, including buildings in Nabatieh and open fields, though no casualties were reported. The attacks follow ongoing military activity in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ቅዳሜ ምሽት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ የአየር እና የጦር መሳሪያ ድብደባዎችን አድርሰዋል። በሁላ ከተማ የሚገኝ የአረጋውያን መጦሪያን ጨምሮ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችና ክፍት ቦታዎች ኢላማ ሆነዋል። ምንም እንኳን ጥቃቶቹ በበርካታ ቦታዎች ላይ ቢደርሱም እስካሁን በሰው ሕይወት ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት አልተዘገበም።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el Dilbata galgala kibba Libnaan keessatti haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi meeshaa gurguddaan gaggeessaniiru. Haleellaan kunneen magaalaa Hulaa keessatti bakka maanguddootni itti kunuunfaman, manneen jireenyaa fi bakkeewwan banaa kanneen biroo kan rukutan yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti namni miidhame hin jiru.

title: Israeli settlers, army continue attacks in West Bank towns
english: Israeli settlers have carried out a series of attacks against Palestinians in several West Bank villages, including shootings and property damage. In some areas, settlers destroyed agricultural land and targeted local residents. Meanwhile, Israeli military forces intervened with tear gas and gunfire during confrontations between settlers and villagers.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ በሚገኙ በርካታ መንደሮች የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በፓለስታይናውያን ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን ቀጥለዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ በገበሬዎች ላይ ተኩስ ከፍተው ንብረታቸውን ለማውደም የሞከሩ ሲሆን የእርሻ መሬቶችንም አውድመዋል። በሌላ በኩል በሰፈራው እና በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች መካከል በተፈጠረ ግጭት የኢስራኤል ወታደሮች የእንባ ጋዝ እና ጥይቶችን ተጠቅመዋል።
oromo: Garee uummatta qubatanii jiraatan (settlers) kan Israa'eel, naannoo Baankii Dhihaa keessatti irratti weerara bal'aa gaggeessaa jiru. Namootni kunneen qonnaan bultoota irratti dhukaasa bananii fi qabeenya isaanii balleessuuf yaalii godhaniiru, akkasumas lafa qonnaa mancaasaniiru. Gamasa biraatiin, waldhabdee uumame hordofee humnoonni waraana Israa'eel gaazii imimmaaniitiin fi dhukaasaan namoota irratti tarkaanfii fudhataniiru.

title: Minority Protection is Ethiopia’s Federal Test
english: Ethiopia faces a critical need to reform its federal system by strengthening constitutional safeguards for minority groups. To ensure national unity, the author suggests creating independent institutions for minority rights, reforming federal representation to prevent demographic dominance, and addressing historical grievances regarding national symbols. These measures are proposed as essential steps for building trust and equality across the country's diverse ethnic and religious communities.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ በፌዴራል ሥርዓቷ ውስጥ አናሳ ብሔረሰቦችን ለመጠበቅ የሚያስችል ጠንካራ የሕገ-መንግስት ማሻሻያ ማድረግ ይጠበቅባታል። የአገሪቱን አንድነት ለማረጋገጥ የአናሳ ብሔረሰቦች መብት የሚከበርባቸው ገለልተኛ ተቋማትን ማቋቋም፣ የፌዴራል ውክልናን ሚዛናዊ ማድረግ እንዲሁም የጋራ ብሔራዊ ምልክቶችን በሚመለከት ያሉ ቅሬታዎችን መፍታት አስፈላጊ መሆኑ ተገልጿል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች በተለያዩ የኅብረተሰብ ክፍሎች መካከል መተማመንን ለመገንባትና እኩልነትን ለማስፈን ወሳኝ ናቸው።
oromo: Itoophiyaan sirna federaalizimii ishee keessatti mirga garee muraasaa eeguuf fooyya'iinsa seera bu'uuraa cimsuun barbaachisaa dha. Tokkummaa biyyaa mirkaneessuuf, dhaabbilee mirga garee muraasaa kabachiisan hundeessuun, bakka bu'iinsa federaalaa madaalamaa taasisuun, akkasumas mallattoolee biyyaalessaa ilaalchisee yaaddoo jiru furuun murteessaa dha. Tarkaanfiiwwan kun saboota fi amantoota adda addaa gidduutti wal amantee fi wal qixxummaa uumuuf bu'uura kan ta'anidha.

title: Norway's new king remembers 'my dear father' in first speech
english: Norway's new monarch, King Haakon VIII, delivered a heartfelt first address to his nation following the passing of his father, King Harald V. He honored his late father’s legacy as a beloved leader and dedicated family man while expressing his commitment to serving the country with attentiveness. The new king also thanked the Norwegian people for their overwhelming support and tributes during this period of national mourning.
amharic: የኖርዌይ አዲሱ ንጉሥ ሃኮን ስምንተኛ፣ አባታቸው ንጉሥ ሃራልድ አምስተኛ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ከተለዩ በኋላ ለሕዝባቸው የመጀመሪያውን ንግግር አድርገዋል። በንግግራቸውም ስለ አባታቸው መልካም አስተዳደር እና ለቤተሰባቸው የነበራቸውን ፍቅር በማውሳት፣ አገራቸውን በትጋት እንደሚያገለግሉ ቃል ገብተዋል። እንዲሁም በሐዘን ጊዜያቸው ከጎናቸው የቆሙትን የኖርዌይ ሕዝቦች ላሳዩት አጋርነት ምስጋናቸውን አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Mootichi haaraan biyya Norwee, Mootii Haakon VIII, erga abbaan isaanii Mootiin Harald V du'anii booda, lammata isaaniitiif haasaa jalqabaa taasisaniiru. Haasaa isaanii keessatti abbaan isaanii hogganaa jaalatamaa fi abba gaarii akka turan yaadachiisuun, isaanis biyya isaanii of eeggannoon tajaajiluuf waadaa galani. Mootichi haaraan kun, yeroo gadda kana keessatti ummanni Norwee cinaa isaanii dhaabbachuun kabajaafi jaalala argisiisaniifis galata guddaa dhiyeessaniiru.

title: Former Ecuadorian president imprisoned for corruption
english: Former Ecuadorian President Lenín Moreno has been sentenced to five years in prison for his role in a bribery scheme involving a Chinese hydroelectric project. Due to his age and disability, he will serve the sentence under house arrest and plans to appeal the court's decision. Several of his family members were also convicted in the case, which centered on millions of dollars in illegal payments made to secure construction contracts.
amharic: የኢኳዶር የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት ሌኒን ሞሬኖ በቻይና የውሃ ኃይል ፕሮጀክት ላይ ጉቦ በመቀበላቸው የአምስት ዓመት እስራት ተፈረደባቸው። በዕድሜያቸው እና በጤና ሁኔታቸው ምክንያት ቅጣታቸውን በቤት ውስጥ እንዲያሳልፉ የተወሰነ ሲሆን ውሳኔውንም እንደሚቃወሙ ገልጸዋል። በዚሁ የሙስና መዝገብ የፕሬዝዳንቱ የቤተሰብ አባላትም ተካተው በሕገ-ወጥ የገንዘብ ዝውውር ጥፋተኛ ተብለዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii Ekuwaador Leeniin Moreenoo pirojektii humna ibsaa Chaayinaa waliin walqabatu keessatti malaammaltummaa fi qabiinsa madda mallaqaa seeraan alaa raawwachuun isaanii mirkanaa'ee waggaa shan akka hidhaman murteeffame. Umrii isaanii fi hirdhina qaamaa isaanii irraa kan ka'e adabbii isaanii mana isaaniitti akka dabarsan kan hayyamameef yoo ta'u, murtoo kanas mormuuf karoorfataniiru. Giddu galeessa dhimma kanaa keessatti miseensonni maatii isaanii kanneen biroos yakka kanaan himatamanii fi adabbiin kan irratti darbe dha.

title: US says far-right provocateur Milo Yiannopoulos has been deported to UK
english: American authorities have deported British provocateur Milo Yiannopoulos back to the United Kingdom after he overstayed his visa. He was arrested by immigration officials at an airport in New Orleans following a judge's order for his removal earlier this year. This incident highlights the U.S. government's ongoing enforcement of immigration laws against individuals who remain in the country beyond their legal authorization.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት የእንግሊዝ ዜግነት ያለውን ማይሎ ያኖፖሎስ የቪዛ ጊዜውን በመጨረሱ ወደ ሀገሩ መመለሳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ግለሰቡ ቀደም ሲል በዳኛ በተላለፈበት የማፈናቀል ትዕዛዝ መሰረት በኒው ኦርሊንስ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ቁጥጥር ስር ውሎ ነበር። ይህ ድርጊት የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከህጋዊ ፍቃድ ውጪ በሀገሪቱ የሚቆዩ ሰዎችን በተመለከተ የያዘውን ጥብቅ አቋም ያሳያል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa namicha beekamaa fi falmisiisaa kan ta'e Milo Yiannopoulos, hayyama yeroo turtiisaa waan darbeef gara biyya isaa Ingilizitti deebiseera. Namichi kun kan qabame buufata xiyyaraa Niyu Orliinsitti yommuu ta'u, kunis murtee mana murtii kanaan dura darbeen kan raawwatame dha. Gochi kun mootummaan Ameerikaa namoota hayyama malee biyyattii keessa turan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu akka itti fufe kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Tunisians desperate for water as taps run dry
english: Tunisia is currently facing a severe water crisis driven by extreme heat, electricity shortages, and outdated infrastructure. Even though the country experienced significant rainfall earlier this year, tap water supplies remain unreliable for many citizens. This situation has led to public protests and forced the government to rely on tanker trucks to distribute water to affected areas.
amharic: ቱኒዚያ በአሁኑ ወቅት በከፍተኛ ሙቀት፣ በኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እና በአሮጌ መሠረተ ልማቶች ምክንያት ለከባድ የውሃ እጥረት ተዳርጋለች። ምንም እንኳን በዚህ ዓመት መጀመሪያ ላይ በቂ ዝናብ ቢዘንብም፣ የቧንቧ ውሃ አቅርቦት ለአብዛኞቹ ነዋሪዎች አስተማማኝ አይደለም። ይህ ችግር የሕዝብ ተቃውሞዎችን ያስነሳ ሲሆን፣ መንግሥትም ለተጎጂዎች በውሃ ተሸከርካሪዎች እርዳታ ለመስጠት ተገዷል።
oromo: Tuniziyaan sababa hoo’a cimaa, hir’ina humna ibsaa fi bu’uraalee misoomaa moofaa ta’aniin yeroo ammaa hanqina bishaanii cimaa keessa jirti. Waggaa kana keessa roobni gahaan roobee kan ture ta’us, bishaan ujummoo namoota hedduuf gahaa miti. Haalni kun mormii uummataa kan kakaase yoo ta’u, mootummaan bakkeewwan hanqinichi jiruuf konkolaataa bishaanii akka dhiyeessu isa dirqisiiseera.

title: US judge rules against Trump’s effort to deport pro-Palestinian students
english: A U.S. federal judge has blocked the Trump administration's attempt to deport international students who participated in pro-Palestinian protests. The court ruled that targeting these students for their political speech violates their constitutional rights. This decision reinforces the principle that freedom of expression in the United States protects both citizens and non-citizens from government retaliation.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌደራል ዳኛ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በጋዛ ጦርነት ላይ ተቃውሞ ባሰሙ የውጭ አገር ተማሪዎች ላይ የወሰደውን የመባረር እርምጃ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ዳኛው፣ መንግስት የፖለቲካ አመለካከታቸውን በመግለጻቸው ተማሪዎችን መቅጣቱ የሕገ መንግሥት መብትን የሚጥስ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የሐሳብን የመግለጽ ነፃነት ለአሜሪካውያን ብቻ ሳይሆን በሀገሪቱ ለሚኖሩ የውጭ ዜጎችም ጭምር የሚሠራ መሆኑን ያረጋግጣል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa Ameerikaa tokko, mootummaan Trump barattoota biyyoota alaa kanneen waraana Gaazaarratti mormii dhageessisaniif biyyattii irraa ari'uuf yaale dhoorkeera. Manni murtichaa gochi mootummaan yaada isaanii ibsatan jechuun barattootarratti tarkaanfii fudhate mirga bu'uuraa kan cabsu ta'uu murteesseera. Murtiin kun, mirgi yaada ofii ibsachuu Ameerikaa keessatti lammiilee qofa osoo hin taane, namoota biyya alaa keessa jiraatan hundaafuu kan eegamu ta'uu mirkaneessa.

title: Haitian gangs release 13 captives after mass kidnapping in Kenscoff
english: Thirteen people, including six children and seven women, were recently freed after being kidnapped during a violent gang attack in Kenscoff, Haiti. The assault, which occurred on August 23, resulted in the deaths of at least 47 people and forced thousands to flee their homes. The United Nations condemned the violence, highlighting the severe instability and growing influence of armed groups in the region.
amharic: በሄይቲ ኬንስኮፍ በተፈጸመ የቡድን ጥቃት ታግተው የነበሩ ስድስት ህጻናትን እና ሰባት ሴቶችን ጨምሮ 13 ሰዎች በቅርቡ ተለቀቁ። ነሐሴ 17 ቀን በተፈጸመው በዚህ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 47 ሰዎች ሲገደሉ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ተገደዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ይህንን ጥቃት ያወገዘ ሲሆን በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን የታጠቁ ቡድኖች ስጋት እና የሀገሪቱን አለመረጋጋት አስረድቷል።
oromo: Haiti, magaalota Kenscoff keessatti garee hidhattootaan namoota butamanii turan keessaa ijoollee ja'aa fi dubartoota torba dabalatee namoonni 13 gadi lakkifamaniiru. Hojiin yakka kanaa guyyaa Hagayya 17 raawwatameen namoonni 47 ol du'aniiru, namoonni kumaan lakkaa'amanis qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii gocha kana kan balaaleffate yoo ta'u, rakkoo nageenyaa fi dhiibbaa gareen hidhattootaa biyyattii keessatti uumaniiru jedheera.

title: Pakistan suspends eight officials over hospital fire that killed 14 babies
english: The Pakistani government has suspended eight hospital officials and launched a criminal investigation following a tragic fire at a neonatal ward in Islamabad that claimed the lives of 14 infants. An inquiry revealed that the facility lacked essential fire safety protocols and suffered from significant staffing shortages at the time of the incident. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif condemned the failure and promised that those responsible for the safety lapses would face strict legal consequences.
